column1: 20217§pierce§pɪəs§The bullet pierced the police officer's vest.§子弹**打穿**了警官的防弹衣。§
20218§incredible§ɪnˈkredəbl§The facts have been distorted to an incredible degree.§事实已被歪曲到**不可信**的地步了。§
20219§vertebrate§ˈvɜːtɪbrət§Even without further expansion they could save around 2,000 species of endangered land vertebrates.§即使没有更大规模的扩展，他们仍能拯救大约2,000种濒危陆生**脊椎动物**。§
20220§industrious§ɪnˈdʌstriəs§Li Ming used to be such an industrious student that he usually got the first grade.§李明过去学习非常**勤奋**，总是排名年级第一。§
20221§intestine§ɪnˈtestɪn§Food passes from the stomach to the small intestine and from there to the large intestine.§食物从胃里先到小**肠**，然后经过小肠到大肠。§
20222§outpost§ˈaʊtpəʊst§There is a remote outpost in the most northern part of the town.§小镇的最北端有一处偏僻的**哨站**。§改例句：most 后应接形容词，north 应为 northern
20223§general§ˈdʒenrəl§The book on the desk is a general one.§课桌上的那本书很**普通**。§
20224§bother§ˈbɒðə(r)§I'm sorry to bother you so early, Mrs Smith.§史密斯女士，很抱歉这么早就来**打扰**您。§
20225§consignment§kənˈsaɪnmənt§We are glad to hear of the post office's making a consignment of bikes.§听说邮局可以**托运**自行车，我们很高兴。§
20226§administrator§ədˈmɪnɪstreɪtə(r)§For sports administrators we provide a four-month certificate course.§对于体育**管理人员**，我们提供为期四个月的证书课程。§
20227§convention§kənˈvenʃn§The city's convention center is also a famous landmark in the country.§该市的**会议**中心也是这个国家的一个著名地标。§
20228§organic§ɔːˈgænɪk§Many synthetic polymers are organic compounds.§很多合成聚合物都是**有机**化合物。§
20229§trapeze§trəˈpiːz§The brothers' trapeze act is unique.§那对兄弟的**高空秋千**表演独一无二。§
20230§intersection§ˌɪntəˈsekʃn§The intersections of these streets with Main Street will not be affected.§这些道路与主干道的**交叉口**将不会受到影响。§
20231§concept§ˈkɒnsept§The concept of health holds different meanings for different people and groups.§健康**观念**因人和群体的不同而不同。§
20232§cardiovascular§ˌkɑːdiəʊˈvæskjələ(r)§People who smoke cigarettes are continually damaging their cardiovascular system.§吸烟者在不断地损害自身的**心血管**系统。§
20233§humble§ˈhʌmbl§They do not wish to return to the humble post-war era.§他们不希望回到那**可怜**的战后年代。§
20234§lecture§ˈlektʃə(r)§I am giving you the lectures on environmental noise this term.§这个学期由我来给你们上环境噪声**课**。§
20235§counter§ˈkaʊntə(r)§The government's plans run counter to agreed European policy on this issue.§政府的计划与欧洲在该问题上的既定政策**相悖**。§
20236§brass§brɑːs§A brass knocker was fixed on the door.§门上装了一个**黄铜**门环。§改译文：原译文末漏了“环。”（knocker 是门环），只剩“黄铜门”，补回
20237§fauna§ˈfɔːnə§They tried their best to protect native flora and fauna.§他们竭尽全力来保护当地的**动**植物。§
20238§expel§ɪkˈspel§John has been expelled from the firm and is operating on his own.§约翰被那家公司**开除**了，现在自己单干。§
20239§equator§ɪˈkweɪtə(r)§The equator divides the earth into two hemispheres.§**赤道**把地球划分为两个半球。§
20240§divisional§dɪˈvɪʒənl§Each branch has a divisional head.§每个分部都有**部门**领导。§
20241§invest§ɪnˈvest§Supermarkets are able to invest millions of pounds in powerful computers which tell them what sells best.§超市可**投资**数百万英镑用于购买功能强大的计算机，这些计算机能告诉他们什么最畅销。§
20242§essay§ˈeseɪ§You have to complete a 3,000-word essay on the topic.§你需要就该主题写一篇3,000字的**文章**。§
20243§dedicate§ˈdedɪkeɪt§We have come to dedicate a portion of that field as a final resting place for those who gave their lives here.§我们已经**贡献出**那片土地的一部分，作为那些在此献出了生命的人们的安息之地。§

20244§astrology§əˈstrɒlədʒi§Although astrology is popular in magazines, most scientists argue that the positions of stars cannot predict human behaviour.§尽管**占星学**在杂志上很受欢迎，但大多数科学家认为星体的位置无法预测人类的行为。§补例句
20245§attain§əˈteɪn§Sustainable development is to attain a perpetual balance between population, economic growth and the environment.§可持续发展就是要**实现**人口、经济增长和环境三者之间的永久平衡。§
20246§ambition§æmˈbɪʃn§Bob's ambition was to study medicine.§鲍勃**有志于**学医。§
20247§range§reɪndʒ§We'd like to produce the equipment with a range of sizes.§我们想生产大小规格**不同**的设备。§
20248§ultimate§ˈʌltɪmət§For early explorers, it was the ultimate survival contest.§对于早期探险家来说，这是**终极**生存竞赛。§
20249§counsellor§ˈkaʊnsələ(r)§Paula Clayburg is the chief counsellor at Liverpool's famous pain clinic.§保拉·克莱伯格是利物浦一家著名止痛诊所的首席**顾问**。§
20250§flap§flæp§Mike bent the flap of an envelope over and stuck it with glue.§迈克把信封的**封口**折过来用胶水黏好。§改例句：bend 的过去式是 bent，bended 错
20251§wastage§ˈweɪstɪdʒ§Quality control cuts wastage and saves time.§质量管理既降低**损耗**又节省时间。§

20252§dub§dʌb§Indeed, some scientists even suggest we should think of each species and its microbes as a single unit, dubbed a "holobiont".§事实上，一些科学家甚至认为我们应将每个物种及其微生物视为一体，**称之为**“共生功能体”。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
20253§device§dɪˈvaɪs§A wide range of pollution control devices is in place at most modern mines.§大多数现代矿井都配备了大量的污染控制**设备**。§
20254§regulate§ˈreɡjuleɪt§More than 300 dams regulate river flows around the country.§有300多座大坝**控制**着全国的河水流量。§
20255§mould§məʊld§A mould might prove to be a successful antibody to bacterial infection.§某种**霉**可能会被证明是细菌感染的有效抗体。§
20256§potential§pəˈtenʃl§After the final interview, potential recruits were divided into three categories.§经过最后一轮面试，**有可能**被录用的人被分成三类。§

20257§discretion§dɪˈskreʃn§The services that the bank will offer you will depend on your individual circumstances and on the discretion of the bank manager involved.§银行提供给你的服务将取决于你的个人情况和相关银行经理的**判断力**。§
20258§ambitious§æmˈbɪʃəs§The Human Genome Project is the most ambitious scientific project since the Apollo programme, which landed a man on the moon.§人类基因工程是继阿波罗登月计划后最具**雄心**的科学项目。§
20259§brief§briːf§The lecture is a brief history of civil engineering development.§这次的讲座内容是土木工程发展的**简**史。§
20260§clamour§ˈklæmə(r)§The clamour from the backyard drew us out of the house.§后院的**喧哗**把我们引出了房子。§改译文：原译文末多出词根助记“参 claim （n. 要求）；proclamation （n. 宣言）；reclamation（n. 回收；开垦）”，删去
20261§substitute§ˈsʌbstɪtjuːt§It is better for a company to employ more workers because people are available to substitute for absent staff.§对公司来说，多雇用一些员工大有好处，因为有足够的人手去**替代**缺勤人员。§
20262§striking§ˈstraɪkɪŋ§The most striking quality of satiric literature is its freshness.§讽刺文学最**显著**的特征是它的新颖性。§
20263§pirate§ˈpaɪrət§Anybody can pirate our music and software without proper laws.§如果没有适当的法规出台，任何人都可以**盗用**我们的音乐和软件。§

20264§attest§əˈtest§Nevertheless, the horse had great ritual and economic significance during the Bronze and Iron Ages, as attested by its depictions on jewellery and other metal objects.§然而，在青铜时代和铁器时代，马匹有很重要的仪式意义和经济意义，这一点可以通过珠宝和其他金属物品的描绘得到**证明**。§
20265§minimise§ˈmɪnɪmaɪz§The adoption of clean energy will help minimise air pollution.§采用清洁能源有助于将空气污染**降到最低程度**。§
20266§imaginative§ɪˈmædʒɪnətɪv§Hypotheses are imaginative and inspirational in character, and are adventures of the mind.§臆测让人充满**想象**与灵感，它是思想的冒险。§
20267§profit§ˈprɒfɪt§Some firms are even downsizing as their profits climb.§一些公司甚至在**利润**上升时还裁员。§
20268§decrepit§dɪˈkrepɪt§Our aim is to remove the heaviest-polluting, most-decrepit vehicles from the roads.§我们的目标是清除公路上污染最严重、最**破旧**的车辆。§
20269§ignorant§ˈɪgnərənt§She is very ignorant about her own job.§她非常**不了解**自己的工作。§
20270§mastery§ˈmɑːstəri§A frequent change of roles is the training requisite for a mastery of the actor's art.§频繁地转换角色是**掌握**表演技能的必要训练。§
20271§forecast§ˈfɔːkɑːst§The economic report forecast a sharp drop in unemployment for the next year.§据经济报告**预测**，来年的失业人数将明显减少。§
20272§precision§prɪˈsɪʒn§The manufacturers exercise much attention and precision in producing their products.§在产品的生产过程中，制造商们倾注了大量心血，非常注重产品的**精密性**。§
20273§representative§ˌreprɪˈzentətɪv§Your examiner is a Student Union representative.§你的主考官是学生会**代表**。§
20274§quote§kwəʊt§The student quotes a paragraph from the classical literature Macbeth.§那名学生**引用**了经典文学作品《麦克白》中的一段话。§
20275§comparative§kəmˈpærətɪv§Tom is living in comparative comfort.§汤姆现在过得**比较**舒服。§
20276§recruit§rɪˈkruːt§You are among the two hundred staff recruited to help look after the old.§你是被**招聘**来帮忙照顾老年人的200名员工之一。§
20277§gloss§glɒs§The kitchen ware can be polished to a gloss.§那些厨房用具能被擦得**闪闪发亮**。§
20278§committee§kəˈmɪti§The committee's decisions are often determined by the members' vote.§**委员会**的决议常常由委员投票决定。§
20279§exile§ˈeksaɪl§The former President was exiled for more than twenty years.§前总统被**流放**了二十多年。§
20280§reverse§rɪˈvɜːs§Small rooms aren't quite cheap in reverse.§小房间**反而**不是很便宜。§
20281§finance§ˈfaɪnæns§Opponents of smoking financed this study.§反对吸烟的人士为这一研究**提供了资金**。§
20282§resign§rɪˈzaɪn§The minister was forced to resign in 2019.§2019年，该部长被迫**辞职**。§
20283§preparation§ˌprepəˈreɪʃn§The team has been training hard in preparation for the big game.§为**备战**这场重要比赛，队伍一直在坚苦训练。§
20284§thrive§θraɪv§Those societies thrived there for more than 1,000 years before the arrival of Europeans.§在欧洲人到来之前，那些社会已经**繁荣**了一千多年。§
20285§judgment§ˈdʒʌdʒmənt§The lawyer is a man of good judgment.§那位律师具有出色的**判断力**。§
20286§outward§ˈaʊtwəd§The scientist warned the local population against being deceived by the volcano's outward calm.§科学家警告当地居民不要被这座火山**表面**的平静所欺骗。§
20287§consequently§ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli§Mr. Foster has never been to China. Consequently he knows very little about it.§福斯特先生从未到过中国，**所以**对中国知之甚少。§
20288§entertain§ˌentəˈteɪn§The spectators go to be entertained rather than out of loyalty to a team.§观众去观看体育比赛与其说是忠于某支球队，还不如说是为了**娱乐**。§
20289§withstand§wɪðˈstænd§A desert animal can withstand high body temperatures.§生活在沙漠中的动物可以**忍受**较高的体温。§
20290§anthropologist§ˌænθrəˈpɒlədʒɪst§The lecturer is an anthropologist.§演讲者是位**人类学家**。§
20291§comb§kəʊm§These temporary hive extensions contain frames of empty comb for the bees to fill with honey.§这些临时扩充的蜂箱里有用来让蜜蜂贮存蜂蜜的空**蜂巢**。§
20292§suitably§ˈsuːtəbli§Based on the soil requirements, the land is suitably fertilised.§根据土壤的条件，土地被**适当**施肥。§
